description: Ministry of Health - Corona Virus Disease 2019 (Covid 19) (Preventive Measures) Regulations
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the Quarantine and Prevention of Diseases Ordinance. It amends existing regulations and establishes new legal requirements for disease prevention measures related to COVID-19, including mask mandates, social distancing rules, movement restrictions, and business operation protocols. This falls under "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" as it involves regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments.
